paragraphs: He is Rabbah bar Chana, and he is mentioned by this name in the Jerusalem Talmud.[^1]

notes.text: The identification as Rabbah bar Chana and mention under this name in the Jerusalem Talmud are Hyman’s explicit statements, preserved with their force. Heading חנא and body חנה remain distinct supplied spellings; no named passage, catalog merge or full personal title is established.
